reviews.frank_statement: FRANK C7 runtime ABI should preserve typed collection semantics such as SET, ORDERED, MULTISET and weighted/priority candidates.
reviews.counterhypothesis: One universal container/row semantics is sufficient and backend defaults can be normalized after execution.
reviews.falsifier: A type-erased compiler preserves declared semantics across adversarial duplicate/order/multiplicity workloads and target backends.
independent_checks: CC12 E2B 30k typed-vs-type-erased SQLite lowering differential
reviews.reason: Typed lowerer had 0/30000 reference mismatches while type-erased lowerers failed in 16947 and 16609 cases; independent collection-semantics literature treats set and bag/multiset as distinct semantic types.

reviews.frank_statement: C7/MOSAIC semantic identity and exact provenance/contract-instance identity should remain separate.
reviews.counterhypothesis: One canonical identity is sufficient for both equivalence and replay ancestry.
reviews.falsifier: A single identity can simultaneously preserve semantic equivalence and exact ancestry without false equality/inequality across target operations.
independent_checks: CC12 E2B reordered/duplicate SET cases preserve semantic hash while contract instances remain distinct
OR-Set/CRDT design independently separates visible set semantics from causal tag history
adversarial_checks: same semantic value under distinct proposal nonce
reviews.reason: New execution preserves semantic equivalence while keeping distinct provenance instances; this is separately analogous to OR-Set visible-value vs causal-tag identity.

reviews.frank_statement: C7/MRSC critical reader handoffs need exact reader-view binding in addition to canonical identity.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Binding only canonical source/contract is enough because the compiler is trusted.
reviews.falsifier: Source-bound receipts detect all emitted-view mutations or target compiler proof makes concrete view binding redundant.
adversarial_checks: mutate ORDERED projected steps while semantic and contract IDs are held fixed
reviews.reason: A concrete view mutation is distinguishable only when exact emitted-view identity is bound; prior CC11 source-only mutation failures remain preserved as ancestry, not independent replication.

reviews.frank_statement: C7 should avoid mandatory verbose JSON on cognition-hot internal ABI paths and use compact typed handles/borrowed buffers where sound.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Target serialization/IPC overhead is dominated by other costs, making a packed ABI unnecessary or harmful.
reviews.falsifier: Target Rust/C/Android runtime benchmark shows no material latency/memory/energy benefit or reveals unacceptable invalidation/safety costs.
adversarial_checks: compare cold identity recomputation with cached hot references; measure receipt byte expansion
reviews.reason: CC12 E2B measured ~15.34 us cold vs ~3.37 us cached-hot proxy and +169 JSON bytes for triple receipt, but this is CPython/E2B, not the target ABI.

reviews.frank_statement: UnifiedDB logical query unification can coexist with specialized physical stores if ClayCode preserves result semantics and plan identity.
reviews.counterhypothesis: Logical unification necessarily erases backend-specific semantics or requires physical consolidation.
reviews.falsifier: Cross-engine target traces show unavoidable semantic loss or unacceptable overhead despite explicit collection/result contracts.
independent_checks: CC12 typed SQLite lowering 0/30000 reference mismatches
independent polystore/cross-model query and typed IR/compiler architecture evidence
reviews.reason: Logical unification is supported only under an explicit result/cardinality/order/weight contract; type-erased unification failed broadly in the constructed corpus.
